result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, heritage-driven page using first-person plural 'we' and absolute phrasing ('We will', 'we remain committed'). Patients are addressed first, then health professionals and employees. Values are stated briefly in a headline list. Framing centres on global health and humanity rather than business metrics. Notable wording: 'Colonel Eli Lilly' founding story and the 'unites caring with discovery' promise.
